categories.main_business_segments: Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electric power equipment manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of transformer series, complete sets of electrical equipment, energy storage series, and digital integrated solutions. The company serves sectors including new energy (wind, photovoltaic, energy storage), data centers, new infrastructure, high-efficiency energy saving, rail transit, and industrial electrical equipment. It also actively develops intelligent industrial robots and digital factory solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced digital manufacturing methods integrating AI, big data, cloud computing, and industrial internet technologies. It has developed core technologies in dry-type transformers, liquid-immersed transformers, energy storage systems, and digital factory software platforms. Key innovations include high-voltage dry-type transformers for wind power, high-voltage direct-hanging energy storage systems, and AI-driven intelligent manufacturing platforms. The company also uses digital twin technology and 5G-enabled smart factories to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global wind turbine manufacturers (e.g., Vestas, GE, Siemens Gamesa), major data center operators (e.g., Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, China Mobile), and industrial enterprises in sectors such as steel, petrochemical, and rail transit. The company serves both domestic and international markets, providing customized power supply solutions for renewable energy, data centers, new infrastructure, and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with products and services covering six continents and 87 countries. It has manufacturing and R&D bases in China (Haikou, Wuhan, Guilin, Shanghai, Yangzhou, Zhejiang, Hunan), as well as overseas facilities in Mexico, the United States, Poland, and Germany. The company actively expands its presence in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electric power equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and integrating transformers, switchgear, energy storage systems, and digital factory solutions. It also engages in upstream R&D and downstream sales and service, providing comprehensive power supply solutions and digital transformation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes digital transformation, AI integration, and green energy technologies. Its R&D focuses on high-voltage dry-type transformers, liquid-immersed transformers, energy storage systems, digital factory platforms, and intelligent industrial robots. It emphasizes innovation in product performance, energy efficiency, and environmental sustainability, with ongoing projects in AI-driven manufacturing, high-voltage energy storage, and smart grid equipment. The company also invests in expanding its patent portfolio and enhancing digital twin and 5G smart factory capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of transformers, switchgear, energy storage systems, and digital factory solutions. The company also earns income from engineering contracting (EPC), installation services, and after-sales technical support. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally, with customized solutions for key clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading global supplier in the electric power equipment industry, especially in transformers and energy storage. It competes with major international manufacturers in wind power transformers and data center power equipment. Its competitive advantages include advanced digital manufacturing, extensive global market reach, strong R&D capabilities, and a diversified product portfolio. The company has received multiple industry awards and certifications, reinforcing its market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.9 billion, a 3.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 574 million, up 13.82%. Total assets reached RMB 9.6 billion, with net assets of RMB 4.45 billion, reflecting strong growth and financial health. The company maintains a stable asset-liability ratio of 53.76% and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures around RMB 356 million annually.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology emphasizes high-quality, customized power equipment solutions with superior performance, reliability, and energy efficiency. Its products are designed for demanding applications in renewable energy, data centers, and industrial sectors, featuring advanced technologies such as high-voltage dry-type transformers and integrated energy storage systems. The company’s digital manufacturing and AI-driven intelligent production provide cost-effective, flexible, and sustainable solutions, enhancing customer value through innovation, global service networks, and commitment to green development.
